parts.text: The sharp centre of this image is the finished scene; the blurred border around it on the left and top is unfinished. Outpaint the blurred border seamlessly: continue the stormy sky, moon glow, sea and rocks, and complete the creature's cut-off left bat wing and lower body so the whole figure sits fully inside the frame. Keep the creature, its size, clay finish and the hooded cultists exactly as they are. Replace the glowing green pentagram on the ground with a plain glowing green ring with no star or symbol inside. No text, no border, no frame.
